curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with who must hold a Nevada license and the thirty-day window for new residents, then the application basics, the validity periods by age, and the co-signer rule for applicants under eighteen.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the age-based license terms versus the identification card term and for the license versus Driver Authorization Card Social Security rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on minimum age, validity periods and what each applicant must prove.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the one-license rule, which tests a new resident always takes, the full list of waiver conditions, who may drive on an out-of-state license, and the national record checks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each waiver condition; contrast cards for the always-given vision test versus waivable tests and for service members versus other non-residents.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a newcomer and asking whether a test can be waived or a Nevada license is needed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the accepted and refused identity documents, name-change proof, immigration documents and limited-term cards, Social Security proof, alternative documents and translation rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each document rule; contrast cards for documents accepted with limits versus refused and for the two expired I-ninety-four cases.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a document and asking whether it proves identity, and for which card.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast the Real ID and standard cards, what a Real ID applicant must bring, then the Driver Authorization Card: its term, its two document lists and the limits on what it can be used for.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for Real ID marks, evidence and the DAC rules; contrast cards for Real ID versus standard cards and for driving privilege versus identification.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which card an applicant can get with given documents and what each card can be used for.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show who must prove a Nevada address, how many residency documents are needed, the special rule for hotel and campground records, the option for applicants under eighteen, and the approved residency forms.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per residency rule; a contrast card for the department forms versus other listed documents.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a residency document and asking whether it counts.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the vision restriction, what the knowledge test checks and how it can be taken, the test fees, the vehicle checks before the road test and what the road test scores.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each test rule; a contrast card for an automatic failure versus a penalized traffic violation.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on test fees, test content and road-test rules.
